question: How can Elexion Automotive's control interface design strategy for 2026 EV models prioritize physical buttons and switches by Q3 2025 to reduce the 30% higher control/display problem rate for EVs and achieve PP100 scores below the 266 EV average?

insights.question: What was the percentage of customer complaints received by Elexion Automotive between 2023 and 2024 that were related to touchscreen interface usability issues?
insights.answer: From the internal quality assurance report completed in Q4 2024, 68% of Elexion Automotive's customers complained about touchscreen interface usability issues, including accidental inputs and delayed response times.

insights.question: In November 2024, what percentage of test drivers reported improved task accuracy when using prototype models that have rotary knobs for key controls?
insights.answer: According to the test drive analysis report published in November 2024 by Elexion Automotive's Quality and Reliability Department, 82% of test drivers reported higher accuracy when using physical rotary knobs compared to touchscreen sliders.

insights.question: Has Elexion Automotive established a date for finalizing the 2026 model control interface design?
insights.answer: Yes, Elexion Automotive established March 31, 2025, as the target date for finalizing the 2026 model control interface design. This timeline will allow 6 months for validation testing and production line integration before full production begins in October 2025.
